card.name: Small words before a key medical noun
card.fires_on: The word "the" (also "to", "during", "before", or the "vere" in "Severe") in label text, right before a noun such as use, presence, number, or early phase.

modes.label: "the" after advised against
modes.description: The word "the" after "advised against" or "testing for", before a noun like use or presence.
modes.example: Patients receiving antihistamines should be advised against<< the>> concurrent use of other CNS depressant drugs

modes.label: Inside "Severe"
modes.description: The "vere" part of "Severe" at the start of a warning heading.
modes.example: 5.2 Se<<vere>> Liver Injury Postmarketing reports indicate that atom

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Short words like "during", "to", or "before" that link a phrase to the next medical term.
modes.example: Instruct patients to take repaglinide tablets within 30 minutes<< before>> meals.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward "continued"-type words and away from words like usage or increment.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a key term such as use, presence, or a severe reaction.
